itens.titulo: Coca-Cola raises earnings outlook as North America business slows
itens.descricao: Coca-Cola raises earnings outlook as North America business slows Yahoo Finance Singapore
trechos: The company posted adjusted earnings of $0.91 per share, above the $0.88 expected by Wall Street analysts, alongside revenue of $13.4 billion, also higher than estimates of $12.9 billion.
Overall unit case volume grew by 5%, more than the roughly 3% expected.
The increase was once again led by Coke Zero, which grew roughly 16% year over year.
Diet Coke and Coca-Cola Light grew by 6%.
"In a nutshell, if you take it out, those two elements, we would be growing, and we see that was a solid result," he told Yahoo Finance, adding that Coke Zero grew by double digits.
Coca-Cola now expects earnings growth of 11%, compared to a prior range of 9% to 10%.
Before that, Coca-Cola previously expected earnings growth in the 8% to 9% range.
"Together with the KFC team, we're definitely going to work on personalized, customized experiences that can help them to continue to grow their business and us together," he added.

itens.titulo: Amazon (AMZN) Q3 Earnings Preview: AWS Growth Takes Center Stage
itens.descricao: Amazon (AMZN) Q3 Earnings Preview: AWS Growth Takes Center Stage Yahoo Finance
trechos: Amazon's Q3 Earnings Expectations The Zacks Consensus Estimate calls for Amazon to post Q3 earnings of $2.01 per share, up 3% year over year, with quarterly revenue projected to increase 12% to $202.11 billion.
Amazon's own guidance called for quarterly sales of $197-$202 billion, with operating income expected to range between $22.5 billion and $26.5 billion.

AWS, AI Chips & Advertising Growth in Focus Amazon Web Services remains a major growth catalyst after AWS revenue surged 37% YoY to $42.23 billion during Q2, marking its fastest expansion in 18 quarters.
Based on Zacks projections, AWS revenue is expected to jump another 37% to $45.41 billion from $33 billion in Q3 2025, supported by growing demand for AI computing and enterprise cloud services.
Meanwhile, Amazon's high-margin advertising business is expected to remain another growth driver, with Q3 ad revenue projected to rise nearly 18% to $20.87 billion.
However, Amazon's anticipated $220 billion in annual capital expenditures raises concerns about free cash flow and whether AWS growth can justify the company's aggressive infrastructure investments.
AMZN Stock Performance & Valuation Amazon shares have risen 10% year-to-date, supported by accelerating AWS growth and improving profitability across its cloud and retail operations.
That said, AMZN has slightly trailed the S&P 500's 11% year-to-date gain and the Nasdaq's 14% return, despite outperforming the Zacks Internet-Commerce industry's 2% decline.

itens.titulo: The Coca-Cola Company Q3 2026 Earnings Call Summary
itens.descricao: The Coca-Cola Company Q3 2026 Earnings Call Summary Yahoo Finance
trechos: Tell us how you invest and we'll show you why it's our #1 pick.
- Organic revenue growth of 7% was driven by a balanced contribution across global markets and categories, supported by 22 consecutive quarters of value share gains.
- Management attributes the system's resilience to a "constructively discontented" culture that prioritizes sharpening consumer insights and adapting execution to local market needs.
- Growth in emerging markets like India and Brazil effectively offset subdued consumer demand in China and weather-related pressures in Japan, validating the company's "all-weather" strategy.

- Flat volume in North America was primarily attributed to the timing of the July 4th holiday and temporary challenges in finished goods, though sequential monthly improvements indicate underlying brand momentum.

2027 Outlook and Strategic Assumptions - Updated 2026 organic revenue guidance of at least 5% incorporates the impact of six fewer selling days in the fourth quarter and anticipated slight destocking across the system.
- Management is front-loading marketing investments in late 2026 to ensure a strong start to 2027, focusing on digital engagement and end-to-end activation for major global events.
- The anticipated refranchising of Coca-Cola Beverages Africa is expected to create an 8-point revenue headwind in 2027 but will structurally improve the company's margin and return profile.
